answer_4.quote: We use the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) crowdsourcing platform to assess models' performance.
answer_4.guideline: we asked people to rate the funniness of titles on a Likert scale of 1-5... we redesigned the study to include two 5-point Likert scale questions: 1) whether the title is funny, and 2) whether the research topic is funny.
